follow-up time: Until children were 6 to 24 months old
exposure: Infant feeding practices (breastfeeding initiation, prelacteal feeds, adequate neonatal feeding)
cohort: 528 mothers with children between the ages of 6 to 24 months
finding: This study found an association between CS delivery and stunting, suggesting that CS delivery may be a risk factor for poor postnatal childhood growth.
mod_finding: Children born through CS were significantly less likely to have initiated breastfeeding within one hour of delivery and more likely to have received prelacteal feeds compared to children born vaginally.
